classification_legend.PLATFORM_BACKED: namespaced cplus_* wrapper delegating to a named host C runtime function; host semantics preserved

probe_note: Host availability was probed at integration time on Apple Clang 16 / macOS arm64; all listed symbols were present. If a host lacks a long-double complex/math entry point, gate it out rather than reimplementing, and regenerate this matrix.
